Package net.filtastisch.cubiCore.utils

Class CloudNetUtils

java.lang.Object
net.filtastisch.cubiCore.utils.CloudNetUtils
public class CloudNetUtils extends Object
Utility class for CloudNet v4 operations. Provides simple access methods for common CloudNet functions.
